title: Miles of Sunrise
style: English, modern country song, clear warm male lead vocals, acoustic guitar, pedal steel guitar, steady bass, brushed snare, melodic chorus, relaxed road trip mood, natural band sound, 96 BPM, complete song
lyrics:
[Verse]
There is dust upon the dashboard
There is coffee in my cup
There is one more town behind me
And the morning coming up

[Chorus]
Miles of sunrise on the highway
Fields of gold beside the road
Every turn can bring me closer
To the place I call my own

[Verse]
There is music in the engine
There is rain upon the screen
I remember all the places
And the people in between

[Chorus]
Miles of sunrise on the highway
Fields of gold beside the road
Every turn can bring me closer
To the place I call my own

[Outro]
There is still a little daylight
And a long way left to go
